title: BPW-2026-0551
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0551
CD ALL
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) S-067 – HAZEN AND SAWYER
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation (BOS) or designee to award TOS S-067 to Hazen and Sawyer from the On-Call Consultant list;
APPROVE a total budget of $2,040,000 (including $503,817 contingency), to fund the services: 1) Develop an odor sampling plan, 2) Conduct odor data collection, 3) Develop and calibrate a Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) model for BOS, and 4). Provide knowledge transfer and training to BOS staff; and
APPROVE the 24-month term of engagement beginning with the Notice-to-Proceed date. Term of engagement not to exceed June 30, 2029.
(W.O.: S10NODOR, C-145655)
summary: Awards a $2,040,000 Bureau of Sanitation task order to Hazen and Sawyer to plan odor sampling, collect odor data and build a hydrogen sulfide model, over a 24-month term.
